scripts.theme:build: vp exec astryx theme build src/lib/default-theme.ts --out src/lib/generated/longlink-neutral-default.css
scripts.build: vp run theme:build && vp run build:prepared
scripts.build:prepared: react-router typegen --mode api && tsc -b && react-router typegen --mode sdk && tsc -b && react-router build --mode api --logLevel warn && react-router build --mode sdk --logLevel warn
scripts.typecheck: vp run theme:build && react-router typegen --mode api && tsc -b && react-router typegen --mode sdk && tsc -b
scripts.typecheck:api: vp run theme:build && react-router typegen --mode api && tsc -b
scripts.typecheck:sdk: vp run theme:build && react-router typegen --mode sdk && tsc -b
scripts.build:api: vp run typecheck:api && react-router build --mode api
scripts.build:api:bundle: vp run theme:build && react-router build --mode api
scripts.build:sdk: vp run typecheck:sdk && react-router build --mode sdk
scripts.build:sdk:bundle: vp run theme:build && react-router build --mode sdk
scripts.dev: vp run theme:build && react-router dev --mode api
scripts.dev:sdk: vp run theme:build && react-router dev --mode sdk
